# schemap Documentation

> Automatic Pydantic v2 schemas from SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM models. Define your model once. Four schemas come for free.

## Overview
- [schemap](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/): Automatic Pydantic schemas from SQLAlchemy models
- [Tutorial](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/tutorial/): Step-by-step guide to generating schemas from your models

## Reference
- [API Reference](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/api/): Complete API docs for schemap functions and decorators
- [Mixins](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/mixins/): Reusable schema mixins for common patterns
- [Examples](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/examples/): Practical examples of schemap in real projects
- [Development](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/development/): Contributing guide and development setup

For the full documentation in a single file, see [llms-full.txt](https://schemap.emiliano-go.com/llms-full.txt).
